description: Use this when the user wants a legal form, contract, agreement, notice, letter or template for a specific country or jurisdiction (36 covered; Quebec is listed separately from Canada). Accepts the document name in English or in the local language. Returns matching forms-legal.com template pages with the link, the statute each template references and a short description. Do not use it to give legal advice, to judge whether a clause is valid or enforceable, or to draft a custom document. Templates are reference documents, not legal advice. Searches are logged with a keyed hash of the anonymized user and conversation IDs the app provides; the search text is kept only when no template fully matches, for up to 30 days (https://forms-legal.com/privacy#api-mcp-plugin).

country.description: Optional jurisdiction: slug, English name or code. Known slugs: usa (United States), uk (United Kingdom), canada (Canada), quebec (Quebec), australia (Australia), new-zealand (New Zealand), ireland (Ireland), singapore (Singapore), uae (United Arab Emirates), hong-kong (Hong Kong), india (India), nigeria (Nigeria), philippines (Philippines), malaysia (Malaysia), kenya (Kenya), ghana (Ghana), pakistan (Pakistan), espana (Spain), mexico (Mexico), colombia (Colombia), chile (Chile), argentina (Argentina), brasil (Brazil), portugal (Portugal), france (France), belgium (Belgium), deutschland (Germany), switzerland (Switzerland), austria (Austria), italy (Italy), netherlands (Netherlands), sverige (Sweden), norge (Norway), suomi (Finland), danmark (Denmark), polska (Poland).

language.description: Optional language for titles and summaries (en, es, pt, de, fr, it, nl, sv, nb, fi, da, pl). "en" returns English titles for every document; omit it to get each document in its own language.

query.description: Document type or keywords, e.g. "tenancy agreement", "deed of absolute sale", "contrato de arrendamiento".

name: search_legal_templates

coverage.description: false when the requested country is not covered; `message` then lists the covered jurisdictions.

match.description: "all": every query word matched; "partial": no template matched every word, these are the closest.

total_matches.description: Documents that matched before the limit was applied.

title: Search legal templates
